Thanks for the forward — quick internal ballpark below. This is designed to be concise so AE can share with Jamie + procurement; numbers are rough, will refine with infra team once they confirm KV-cache/batching profile from the CSV.

Summary assumptions (for the table):
- Monthly tokens baseline: 224M (prompt+completion) per Jamie sample
- Token mix: 92% handled on 8k path, 8% require 32k kernels, ~0.05% 128k tail
- We assume streaming not required for the majority; streaming add-on increases latency but is priced on marginal token work.

Ballpark unit economics (hosted, pay-as-you-go):
- 8k baseline: $420 per 1M tokens (prompt+completion)
- 32k context (kernel/kv extra overhang): 1.6x premium => $672 per 1M tokens when a request requires 32k memory path
- 128k tail: 3.5x premium => $1,470 per 1M tokens for rare long-context sessions

Dedicated / committed capacity (12-month):
- Reserved pool pricing: approximately $320 per 1M tokens equivalent (8k workload), subject to a minimum monthly commit (we'd propose $150k/month spend or equivalent commit for the Acme profile)
- 32k/128k tail handled via compatibility instances or overflow to hosted at the hosted premium rates; we can layer in a negotiated premium if they want dedicated to cover tails entirely

Other notes:
- For ~224M tokens/mo, at $420/1M the hosted burn is ~$94k/month; at $320/1M committed that's ~$72k/month (material delta that justifies a commit if they can sign a 12m deal)
- If they want tighter latency SLOs (P95 < 200ms for 8k), we’ll want to discuss dedicated guards or priority lanes; those push towards higher commit or a higher unit rate for hosted priority traffic

Suggested next steps to send to Acme:
1) Quick table: (hosted vs dedicated) with the unit $/1M above and example monthly totals for 224M tokens.
2) Ask for 3- and 12-month forecast to size commit tiers.
3) Offer a short technical call with our infra team on the 32k tail handling (30–45 min) to finalize whether tails should overflow to hosted or be included in Dedicated.
4) If they like the numbers, we propose Sales Ops set up a procurement call with Samir to go over PO and term sheet.

I can draft the email to Jamie summarizing these bullets if you want an AE-friendly version — otherwise please share and I’ll refine.

— Rishi
Head of Pricing & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
